biotools.summary: OrganPipe is a pipeline for automated assembly, annotation, and curation of mitochondrial and chloroplast genomes. It utilizes iterative assembly and multiple k-mer combinations to overcome limitations of existing tools and is accessible to users with limited bioinformatics experience.
